# stat

Print selected GNU stat fields for filesystem entries.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/stat -c '%n %s' notes.txt
moonx cli/stat -Lc '%F %Y' current
```

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-c VALUE`, `--format VALUE` | Print the selected fields and a newline. |
| `-L`, `--dereference` | Follow symbolic links. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Use --format with %n, %F, %s, %X, %Y, %Z and %%. Size requires a regular file. Raw mode, ownership, inode numbers and allocated blocks require additional metadata.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md).
